thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate and tail latency in eu-north-1 affecting Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Trigger: 5xx > 4% for 5m.

raj_oncall: I’m paged in. Confirming dashboards now.

emma_prod: seeing spikes in 500s from the text-generation endpoint in eu-north-1. Error traces point to downstream auth token validation calls timing out.

mike_sre: also seeing a bump in request latency for /v1/generate with many requests stuck waiting on auth provider (latency 800-1200ms) and subsequent 502/504s.

oliver_eng: replays in logs show Auth0 (auth-redwood-prod) 503s and a flurry of 429s from our observability ingest (we're dropping some spans). Might be a double-whammy: AWS networking degradation + third-party auth throttling.

tessa_support: CS flagged 3 paying customers in eu who saw timeouts. One on Dedicated reported retry storms from client SDK.

raj_oncall: timeline: ~1876543000 start of small error increase, hit alert at 1876543210. TAG: third-party-auth + regional-aws.

emma_prod: immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply routing fallback for eu-north-1 -> eu-west-1 for new incoming requests 2) throttle retries at the gateway 3) switch token validation to cached local verification for short-lived tokens if possible.

mike_sre: Initiating Reroute policy now. Pushing a temporary route override: route-policy: region_fallback eu-north-1->eu-west-1 with clamp_concurrency 40%. Will monitor.

incident-bot: action: Reroute policy applied by mike_sre at 1876543325.

oliver_eng: pushing a small change to the auth validator: enable local JWT signature check as fallback (no introspect) to reduce outbound calls to Auth0. Patch preview:

```
# snippet from validator config
AUTH_VALIDATOR_FALLBACK=local_jwt
INTROSPECT_TIMEOUT=200ms
CACHE_TTL_SECONDS=60
```

emma_prod: rolling that to a canary on 3 hosts in eu-north-1 (canary ids: ded-eu-n-3a, hosted-eu-n-2b, hosted-eu-n-2c).

tessa_support: drafting customer status update. Suggest: brief, mention degraded generation for eu region, we have automated fallback to eu-west-1, mitigations in place, and we’re working with Auth0 + AWS.

kate_pmgr: include ETA: monitoring for reduction within 20m; offer targeted follow-up for impacted Dedicated customers.

aws-status-bot: AWS Health: Investigating: EU-NORTH-1 network reachability issues reported. Reference: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incident/eu-north-1/2026-03-15

raj_oncall: good — AWS acknowledged. Need to confirm whether auth provider incidents are related (Auth0 posted elevated errors in EU).

oliver_eng: Auth0 status shows high latency for introspect endpoints in EU at 1876543300. We should avoid introspect for now.

mike_sre: I'm lowering client-side retry multiplier and enabling jitter in the API gateway:

```
# gateway config change applied by mike_sre
RETRY_ENABLED=true
MAX_RETRIES=1
(RETRY_BACKOFF_MS) = 200-800 jitter
```

incident-bot: action: Gateway retry policy updated at 1876543350.

emma_prod: canary auth-fallback rolled successfully. Observability: canary 3 hosts show 60% reduction in 5xx locally. Overall 5xx across eu-north-1 down from 4.8% -> 2.1% after reroute + local auth check. Latency p95 improved from 1100ms -> 520ms.

tessa_support: CS update draft: "We experienced elevated errors and latency for Hosted API and some Dedicated pools in the EU-North region. Traffic is being routed to eu-west-1 while we mitigate. Some requests may see higher latency. We're following up individually with impacted teams." Approval?

kate_pmgr: approve. Add: "We are working with AWS and our auth provider to restore normal routing; no data loss reported."

raj_oncall: escalate to incident commander if 5xx stays >2.5% for another 10m. Current metrics trending down but still above baseline.

mike_sre: kicking off synthetic checks from other regions to ensure fallback is healthy. Also temporarily raising dedicated pool capacity in eu-west-1 to absorb rerouted traffic.

incident-bot: action: increased capacity for Dedicated eu-west-1 by +2 nodes at 1876543500 (autoscaling override).

oliver_eng: observability vendor (Honeycomb) ingestion showed delays, so some traces missing. We're toggling sampling to force key traces to get through: sampling override for auth endpoints = 100%.

emma_prod: monitoring customer-visible error counts: currently 48 affected requests/min (was 200/min). We'll keep channel open for handoff to midnight oncall in case AWS or Auth0 degrade again.

tessa_support: sent CS update at 1876543560 and copied in account execs for impacted customers.

raj_oncall: handing off to night oncall (maria_noc) in 20m. Handoff notes:
- root cause: AWS eu-north-1 network degradation + Auth0 introspect latency causing cascade
- mitigations applied: region fallback to eu-west-1, gateway retry clamp, local JWT fallback, increased eu-west-1 capacity, sampling overrides
- current status: 5xx at 1.9% and p95 latency ~480ms in eu-north-1 after reroute; watching for Auth0 recovery and AWS resolution
- next steps: watch for AWS status updates, coordinate with Auth0 if errors persist, prepare rollback of fallback when stable

mike_sre: added incident timeline to the incident tracker and pinned runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/aws-region-outage.

incident-bot: incident severity set to SEV2 by raj_oncall at 1876543650.

kate_pmgr: thanks team. Please queue a post-incident writeup and include customer impact summary + timeline. I’ll coordinate the customer outreach.

mike_sre: handoff complete. tagging maria_noc for night watch. @maria_noc please ack when you take it.

maria_noc: acknowledged. I'll watch metrics and escalate if it creeps back up.

incident-bot: thread closed for now at 1876543800 (monitoring-only)."
